report_name: LHC Group Discloses Health Data Breach Affecting Over 162,000

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Vishing Actor
threat_actors.description: An unnamed threat actor responsible for a voice phishing (vishing) attack against an LHC Group employee. The actor stole credentials to access a third-party vendor's platform and exfiltrate sensitive patient data.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor initiated the attack using a voice phishing (vishing) call to deceive an employee and steal their credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Voice
attack_patterns.description: A threat actor impersonated a trusted entity over a phone call to deceive an LHC Group employee into divulging their login credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor used the employee credentials stolen via vishing to gain legitimate, authenticated access to a third-party technology vendor's platform.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The attacker accessed and exfiltrated a large volume of files containing sensitive patient data from a third-party vendor's cloud platform used for care coordination.

attack_patterns.name: Automated Exfiltration
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor exfiltrated a large volume of files containing sensitive personal information and Protected Health Information (PHI) of patients over an eight-day period.

identities.name: LHC Group, Inc.
identities.description: A major U.S. provider of home health and hospice care that was the target of a data breach originating from a vishing attack on an employee.

identities.name: UnitedHealth Group
identities.description: The parent company of Optum, which in turn is the parent of the breached entity, LHC Group.

identities.name: Optum
identities.description: A subsidiary of UnitedHealth Group and the parent division of the breached entity, LHC Group.

identities.name: 162,578 Affected Individuals
identities.description: The group of 162,578 patients whose sensitive personal information and Protected Health Information (PHI) were exposed in the data breach.
